name: OpenMontage
description: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files. Turn your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.
one_liner: Turns your AI coding assistant into a full video production team: it can write a script, generate footage, add narration and music, and edit it all into a finished video.
buyer: A small marketing team or solo content creator who needs a steady stream of short videos, like ads, explainers, or social clips, but can't afford a video production agency.
business_use_cases: A small e-commerce brand generates weekly product demo and ad videos in-house instead of hiring a video agency.
A content creator produces a daily short-form video series for a few dollars of compute instead of days of manual editing.
A marketing agency offers cheap, fast AI-produced video packages to small-business clients who can't afford traditional video production.

money_ideas.idea: Run a video-as-a-service shop: clients describe the video they want, you run it through OpenMontage and deliver a finished cut.
Offer a monthly content-video subscription for small businesses: a set number of social or ad videos produced each month.

steal_this: This weekend, pick one of the project's example prompts, produce 3 short promotional videos for a real local business, and pitch them as a paid sample package.
